titulo_original: ESPN Deportes, ESPN, & Tribeca Studios Presents: 13.4 Seconds To Nowhere + Shooting Stars: The Adrián Solano Story

sinopsis.es: Adrián Solano, un venezolano de 22 años que nunca ha visto nieve, entra accidentalmente a los Campeonatos Mundiales de Esquí Nórdico de 2017. Coronado 'el peor esquiador del mundo', demuestra que la grandeza se mide en coraje.
sinopsis.en: Adrián Solano, a 22-year-old Venezuelan who has never seen snow, accidentally enters the 2017 Nordic World Ski Championships. Crowned 'The World's Worst Skier' by the internet, he proves that greatness is measured in courage, not medals.
